data.title: feat(benchmarks): bump ALLEGRO o1, CLD o2 and IDEA o1 to their latest versions and continue the old versions' regression series
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
## Summary

Updates the nightly benchmarks to use the latest detector geometry versions:

- ALLEGRO o1: `v03` → `v04`
- CLD o2: `v08` → `v09`
- IDEA o1: `v03` → `v04`

Since changing the detector configuration would otherwise start a completely new regression series, this PR also adds detector-version succession to the regression lineage. The new configurations can therefore continue the history of the versions they replace while still treating the switch itself as a distinct boundary.

Regression reporting, blame attribution, ranking, emails and the dashboard are updated accordingly so that detector switches are handled explicitly and are not mistaken for software regressions.

The PR also:

- makes same-release detector switches work correctly in regression windows

data.title: Remove filesystem detection and require GCC 9.1+
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
 - CMake: Remove filesystem detection logic and require GCC 9.1+

ENDRELEASENOTES

TryFileSystem.cpp was being incorrectly installed to the cmake directory due to the `*.cpp` pattern in the install command.

GCC 9.1+ and libc++ from LLVM 9+ have full std::filesystem support without needing extra link libraries. The complex detection that tested stdc++fs, c++fs, and Boost::filesystem fallback was only needed for older compilers like GCC 8.

- Add a minimum GCC version check (9.1)
- Remove try_compile-based filesystem detection loop
- Remove Boost::filesystem fallback
- Delete cmake/TryFileSystem.cpp (no longer needed)
- Remove `*.cpp` from cmake install pattern
- Remove `FS_LIBRARIES` and the `USE_BOOST_FILESYSTEM` code path in GaudiPluginService

data.title: Shrink Request Details grid gap to match Approvals/Activity spacing
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body: Bulma's is-variable is-3 doubles to a 1.5rem effective gap (each column pads all sides by the full value), vs. the 0.5rem gap-2 utility used for Approvals/Activity rows elsewhere on the same page. Switched both the display grid and its matching inline-edit form to is-1 (0.5rem total) to match.

data.title: Fix non-resizable textareas and add auto-grow with a graceful fallback
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Fixes #93.

- Notes (create form) and both comment textareas had resize:none with tiny fixed rows — enabled resize:vertical as the universal default
- Layer field-sizing: content on top via @supports: supporting browsers get an auto-growing textarea with no resize handle/scrollbar for typical content, older browsers fall back to plain manual resize
- Move resize off inline style attributes (which were silently overriding the stylesheet) into the stylesheet itself, so the @supports override can actually take effect
- Reduce textarea border-radius so the native resize handle/scrollbar clash less with the rounded corner
- Give the shared edit modal a larger min/max height than other textareas

data.title: Render Markdown in Additional Notes and remove dead edit templates
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
Fixes #94.

- Additional Notes was the only prose-type field missing data-md wiring — Title, Description, and comments already had it
- Remove the orphaned detail_edit_description/detail_edit_notes templates, unreachable since #35 switched those edit buttons to the shared modal without deleting the old per-section forms

data.title: Add Detector(s) field, required for final processing stages other than generation
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
- New freeform Detector(s) field on requests, comma-separated for multiple (e.g. IDEA, ALLEGRO, ALFA), rendered as pills on the detail page
- Required whenever Final Processing Stage is anything other than generation, enforced client-side (conditional field) and server-side (create + submit-to-pending)
- Shown in notification emails alongside Final Processing Stage
- Normalize "Final Processing Stage" wording everywhere (was inconsistently "Processing Stage" in a few spots)

data.title: Fix duplicate header on session expiry and silent 403s in htmx requests
data.author: kjvbrt
data.body:
- RequireAuth now sends HX-Redirect: /login for htmx requests instead of a plain 303, so the browser's XHR doesn't silently follow the redirect and partial-swap the full login page (header included) into whatever narrow target the original request specified
- Add an htmx:responseError listener that shows the server's error text via the existing showAlert modal, since htmx doesn't swap 4xx/5xx responses by default and there was previously no feedback at all on a 403

data.title: Update k4_local_repo for the Gaudi 41 install layout
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
With the change to Gaudi 41.0, plugins are now installed in `lib/gaudi-plugins` (or `lib64/gaudi-plugins`) and Python files in `lib/python<version>/site-packages` (or `lib64/python<version>/site-packages`). This updates `k4_local_repo` in both the nightlies and releases setup scripts accordingly:

- Prepend `install/lib/python<version>/site-packages` and `install/lib64/python<version>/site-packages` to `PYTHONPATH`. The Python version is taken from the current `python`. Both paths are always added since `k4_local_repo` may be run before installing, so it's not possible to check which one exists.
- Prepend `install/lib/gaudi-plugins` and `install/lib64/gaudi-plugins` to `GAUDI_PLUGIN_PATH` (keeping `lib` and `lib64` afterwards).
- Remove a duplicated line in `setup-releases.sh` that was…

data.title: Make sure to only copy data that the model has actually returned
data.author: tmadlener
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- Make sure to only copy data to the `output` that the model actually returns when running inference

ENDRELEASENOTES

- [x] Includes #17 

Previously we unconditionally memcpy-d as many elements as we could fit
into output. However, output is in some cases a maximum number of
elements not an exact number of elements that the model will return from
inference. Hence, we read garbage data past the actual data returned
from the inference. It has been without consequence so far because we
haven't touched that data later until now and apparently we had large
enough memory pages to not trigger a seg fault.

data.title: Install the python package to GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
 - Install the k4FWCore python package to `${GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR}` instead of the hardcoded `python` directory, so that it ends up in the same directory as the `k4FWCorePluginsConf.py` generated by Gaudi.

ENDRELEASENOTES

The python sources of k4FWCore are installed to a hardcoded `python/k4FWCore`, but the `k4FWCorePluginsConf.py` generated by Gaudi is installed to `${GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR}/k4FWCore`. Up to now both were the same directory because Gaudi defaulted `GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR` to `python`.

Gaudi v41r0 changes the install layout: plugins (and their `.confdb`/`.components` files) are now installed to `lib/gaudi-plugins` (https://gitlab.cern.ch/gaudi/Gaudi/-/merge_requests/1928), and `GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR` defaults to `lib/pythonX.Y/site-packag…
